title: Saved Search Template Performance Leaderboard
prompt: Your real estate platform runs A/B tests pairing two saved-search templates head-to-head on the same day, measuring how many property inquiries each generates. The `ab_tests` table records each test as one row with `template_a_id`, `template_b_id`, `inquiries_a`, and `inquiries_b`. A template wins a test if it generates strictly more inquiries; a tie awards 1 point to each; a loss awards 0. Calculate total points for every template (including templates that never appeared in any test) and report `template_id`, `template_name`, and `total_points`. Order by `total_points` DESC, then `template_id` ASC.
schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE search_templates (template_id INT PRIMARY KEY, template_name VARCHAR(100)); CREATE TABLE ab_tests (test_id INT PRIMARY KEY, template_a_id INT, template_b_id INT, inquiries_a INT, inquiries_b INT, test_date DATE);
example_input_data: INSERT INTO search_templates (template_id, template_name) VALUES (1, 'Urban Loft Finder'), (2, 'Family Suburb Search'), (3, 'Luxury Waterfront'), (4, 'Budget Studio Scan'); INSERT INTO ab_tests (test_id, template_a_id, template_b_id, inquiries_a, inquiries_b, test_date) VALUES (101, 1, 2, 15, 10, '2024-01-05'), (102, 1, 3, 8, 8, '2024-01-06'), (103, 2, 3, 12, 18, '2024-01-07'), (104, 3, 1, 20, 14, '2024-01-08');

composite_moves: unpivot both sides of ab_tests via UNION ALL into (template_id, own_inquiries, opp_inquiries)
per-row CASE scoring: own > opp -> 3 points, own = opp -> 1 point, own < opp -> 0 points
LEFT JOIN search_templates to include templates with no tests, COALESCE points to 0
ORDER BY total_points DESC, template_id ASC

hints: Each test row represents two templates competing; you need to count points for both sides.
Use UNION ALL to split each test into two rows, one per template, carrying its own inquiries and the opponent's.
A CASE expression can assign points based on comparing own inquiries to opponent inquiries (win=3, draw=1, loss=0), then SUM those points per template.
answer_key: WITH split AS (SELECT template_a_id AS template_id, inquiries_a AS own, inquiries_b AS opp FROM ab_tests UNION ALL SELECT template_b_id, inquiries_b, inquiries_a FROM ab_tests), scored AS (SELECT template_id, CASE WHEN own > opp THEN 3 WHEN own = opp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS points FROM split), totals AS (SELECT template_id, SUM(points) AS total_points FROM scored GROUP BY template_id) SELECT t.template_id, t.template_name, COALESCE(tot.total_points, 0) AS total_points FROM search_templates t LEFT JOIN totals tot ON t.template_id = tot.template_id ORDER BY total_points DESC, t.template_id ASC;

_meta.scenario: a real estate listing platform tracking saved searches and inquiry rates
